source: USGS Water Data API gauges; beaches (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL
note: level = lake-level gauge on the lake or within 2 km; rain / flow = nearest rain / stream-flow gauge within 25 km (km = distance from the lake's shore, 0 = on the lake); a big lake (100 km2+) has none, and shoreGauges = [rain ids, flow ids] near its shore instead. beaches: null = not looked up yet, [] = none mapped; onshoreWindFrom = compass direction from the beach toward the water; kind b = beach, s = swimming area, p = beach park. A lake with no row has no gauge nearby and no beaches mapped (unless it's in beachesNotLookedUp).
